flows.title: Write and send an email
steps: At the top left, click Compose.
In the To field, add recipients. Recipients can also go in the Cc and Bcc fields.
Add a subject and write the message.
At the bottom of the message, click Send.

flows.title: Search for email
steps: At the top, in the search bar, enter what to search for and press Enter.
Under the search box, select a chip such as From, Any time, Has attachment or Is unread to narrow the results.
For more options, click Show search options in the search box, fill in any of the fields, then click Search.

flows.title: Create a label and apply it
steps: On the left, next to Labels, click Create new label.
Enter a label name. To put it inside another label, check the box next to Nest label under. Click Create.
To label an email, check the box next to it, click Labels at the top, and select the label.
